name: sacrosacred
source:
were you afraid to be holy, sacrosanct. or was that just what I made you. didn't you want to be worshipped? you, curse-god, you.

what I wanted was to be loved (by god).

[From [url=https://swanchime.itch.io/sacrosacred]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你害怕成为圣洁、神圣不可侵犯吗？或者这就是我创造的你。你不想被崇拜吗？你，诅咒之神，你。

我想要的是被（上帝）爱。

[来自[url=https://swanchime.itch.io/sacrosacred]itch.io[/url]]
